caption: Diagram 3.6 | Wheelchair storage and transfer space General storage space
description: The drawing is a plan (top view) showing two wheelchairs drawn one above the other, each seen from above with seat, back and armrests. A vertical dimension line on the left, labelled 1700mm, runs the full height of the two wheelchairs together. A horizontal dimension line across the top is split into two segments: 1100mm, which matches the width of a single wheelchair, and 1200mm, which measures the space from the wheelchair's side edge to a vertical line on the right, representing the transfer area. A leader line from the right edge of the lower wheelchair points to the label "Power socket". Beneath the diagram a note reads "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted". The green footer at the bottom of the image states "Diagram 3.6" followed by "Wheelchair storage and transfer space".
